title: CrossDepth: Geometry-Constrained Attention for Generalizable Multi-View Surround Depth Estimation
summary: Reliable 3D understanding of the surrounding environment is a core requirement for autonomous driving. Multi-view surround camera rigs provide broad scene coverage, but the spatially adjacent images typically overlap only minimally. Consequently, the depth of most pixels must be inferred from monocular appearance cues. These cues can appear differently across images and may therefore be interpreted differently by the depth estimation model. We target two main sources of cross-image inconsistency: differences in camera intrinsics and the limited receptive field of each image. We address the former by conditioning the features on per-pixel camera-aware ray embeddings, enabling the network to account for camera-dependent variations in monocular cues. We address the latter by extending each pixel's context beyond its own image through cross-image attention constrained to geometrically plausible regions, derived from the calibrated rig setup. The model is trained in a fully self-supervised manner based on photometric consistency. Evaluations on DDAD and nuScenes show improved overall depth accuracy and cross-image depth consistency over state-of-the-art self-supervised methods under in-domain and cross-domain evaluation. Code is available at https://abualhanud.github.io/CrossDepthPage/.

AI.title_zh: CrossDepth：用于泛化多视角环视深度估计的几何约束注意力
AI.abstract_zh: 可靠的三维周围环境理解是自动驾驶的核心要求。多视角环视相机系统提供了宽阔的场景覆盖范围，但空间上相邻的图像通常仅有非常小的重叠。因此，大多数像素的深度必须从单目外观线索中推断。这些线索在不同图像之间可能表现不同，因此深度估计模型可能对其作出不同解释。我们针对跨图像不一致性的两个主要来源：相机内参的差异和每张图像的有限感受野。我们通过将特征条件化于逐像素的相机感知射线嵌入来解决前者，使网络能够解释单目线索中与相机相关的变化。我们通过将每个像素的上下文扩展到其自身图像之外，通过约束在几何上合理的区域（由标定好的相机系统导出）上的跨图像注意力来解决后者。该模型基于光度一致性以完全自监督的方式进行训练。在DDAD和nuScenes上的评估表明，在域内和跨域评估下，相较于最先进的自监督方法，整体深度精度和跨图像深度一致性均有所提升。代码可在https://abualhanud.github.io/CrossDepthPage/获取。

title: What Matters, When? Diagnosing and Improving Conditional Visual Grounding in Visuomotor Imitation Policies
comment: Accepted as an extended abstract at the DexHAND Workshop, ECCV 2026. Non-archival, non-proceedings. 4 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: Visuomotor imitation policies can achieve high performance under in-distribution visual conditions yet fail when visually similar objects or receptacles are introduced. We study this behavior as a problem of conditional visual grounding: the visual target required for successful control changes with the manipulation phase and, in more complex tasks, with the observed task state. Using Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), we systematically introduce distractor objects and receptacles with controlled color and shape similarity and localize failures to picking and placement. We find that distractor sensitivity is specific to both the type of visual similarity and the manipulation stage. Guided by this diagnosis, we evaluate distractor augmentation, phase-dependent attention regularization, and appearance-based visual prompting as complementary interventions for improving target selection while preserving spatial information required for control. These interventions substantially improve robustness in simulation and on a physical UR3e. We further examine the same failure pattern in a pretrained vision-language-action policy on a state-conditioned instrument-handling task, where the observed state of a medical instrument determines the correct destination. Together, the results show that visual distractors can cause incorrect object or destination selection even when the underlying manipulation skill remains intact, and that explicitly improving target selection can substantially recover performance across distinct visuomotor policy-learning regimes.

AI.title_zh: 何时何事重要？视运动模仿策略中条件性视觉定位的诊断与改进
AI.abstract_zh: 视运动模仿策略在分布内视觉条件下能够取得高性能表现，但当引入视觉上相似的物体或容器时则可能失效。我们将这一行为研究为条件性视觉定位问题：成功控制所需的视觉目标会随着操作阶段而变化，在更复杂的任务中还会随着观察到的任务状态而变化。利用基于Transformer的动作分块（ACT），我们系统地引入具有受控颜色和形状相似度的干扰物体与容器，并将失败定位到抓取和放置环节。我们发现，对干扰物的敏感性既取决于视觉相似性的类型，也取决于操作阶段。在这一诊断的指导下，我们评估了干扰增强、相位相关的注意力正则化以及基于外观的视觉提示，作为改善目标选择同时保留控制所需空间信息的互补干预措施。这些干预措施在仿真环境和真实UR3e机械臂上显著提升了鲁棒性。我们进一步在预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略上考察了相同的失效模式，应用于一个状态条件的器械操作任务，其中观察到的手术器械状态决定了正确的目的地。综合来看，结果表明：即使底层操作技能保持完好，视觉干扰物也可能导致错误的物体或目的地选择；而显式改善目标选择能够在不同的视运动策略学习范式下显著恢复性能。

title: RoboSPA: Can VLA Models Go Beyond Simple Scenes and Short-Horizon Tasks?
comment: Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising progress in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, existing datasets and benchmarks mainly evaluate task completion under predefined settings, offering limited insight into model reasoning under increasing spatial and procedural complexity. We introduce \textbf{RoboSPA} (\textbf{Robo}t \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{P}rocedural \textbf{A}ssessment), a large-scale robotic manipulation dataset and benchmark for diagnosing embodied reasoning in VLA models. \texttt{RoboSPA} focuses on two core dimensions, Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning and Long-Horizon Procedural Planning, covering 10 task categories and 56 base tasks. Each task is instantiated across five difficulty levels, yielding 280 variants with increasing spatial ambiguity and procedural complexity. We collect 527K trajectories across multiple embodiments and diverse scenes. Beyond binary success rate, \texttt{RoboSPA} introduces diagnostic metrics for more detailed evaluation. Experiments on representative VLA models show that current systems still struggle with complex spatial relations, precise low-level execution, and memory-intensive planning. These results establish \texttt{RoboSPA} as a challenging diagnostic benchmark for developing more capable, reliable, and generalizable embodied agents. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/fanzhenxuan/RoboSPA.

AI.title_zh: RoboSPA：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能否超越简单场景和短时程任务？
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在语言条件下的机器人操作方面已展现出有前景的进展。然而，现有数据集和基准主要评估在预定设置下的任务完成情况，对于模型在日益增长的空间复杂性和程序复杂性下推理能力的洞察有限。我们引入\textbf{RoboSPA}（\textbf{Robo}t \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{P}rocedural \textbf{A}ssessment，机器人空间-程序评估），这是一个用于诊断VLA模型中具身推理的大规模机器人操作数据集和基准。\texttt{RoboSPA}聚焦于两个核心维度：细粒度空间推理和长时程程序规划，涵盖10个任务类别和56个基础任务。每个任务在五个难度等级上进行实例化，产生280个变体，其空间模糊性和程序复杂性不断增加。我们收集了跨越多种具身形态和多样化场景的527K条轨迹。除二元成功率之外，\texttt{RoboSPA}还引入了诊断性指标以进行更详细的评估。在代表性VLA模型上的实验表明，当前系统在处理复杂空间关系、精确的低层执行以及记忆密集型规划方面仍然存在困难。这些结果将\texttt{RoboSPA}确立为一个具有挑战性的诊断基准，用于开发更强大、更可靠、更具泛化能力的具身智能体。我们的数据和代码可在https://github.com/fanzhenxuan/RoboSPA获取。

title: TourPhysics: Bringing Physics to World Models for Exploration and Manipulation from a Single Image
summary: Interactive visual world models must distinguish observation from physical intervention. Camera motion reveals new surfaces, whereas intervention changes object motion, contact, and deformation. Current video world models are largely driven by appearance priors and often lose physical or spatial consistency over long horizons. We present TourPhysics, an online framework initialized from a single image and a declarative physical configuration. TourPhysics extends PhysOmni, our ACM Multimedia 2026 work, from finite physics-grounded video synthesis to persistent exploration and manipulation. TourPhysics combines deterministic simulation with video generation while assigning separate roles to simulator state, geometric evidence, generator controls, and appearance memory. For each action, the simulator computes a finite physical and camera trajectory before the corresponding observation is generated. Accepted observations publish the terminal state and update the appearance memory and subsequent generator controls, while the committed state and simulator geometry remain fixed throughout synthesis and retry. We further separate the simulator geometry used for projection and visibility from the relative depth used to condition the generator. A reference-anchored memory retrieves accepted static appearance through geometric cross-view correspondence and incorporates it through a bounded residual that reverts to the native path when no valid correspondence exists. On simulator-defined camera tours and object manipulations, TourPhysics follows prescribed camera and object trajectories more closely than the evaluated baselines, preserves the input scene, and reduces appearance drift during long-horizon revisits.

AI.title_zh: TourPhysics：将物理引入世界模型，实现从单张图像的探索与操作
AI.abstract_zh: 交互式视觉世界模型必须区分观察与物理干预。相机运动揭示新的表面，而干预则会改变物体的运动、接触和形变。当前的视频世界模型主要受外观先验驱动，在长时间跨度上往往会丧失物理或空间一致性。我们提出TourPhysics，这是一个从单张图像和声明式物理配置初始化的在线框架。TourPhysics将我们的ACM多媒体2026工作PhysOmni从有限的物理驱动视频合成扩展到持续的探索与操作。TourPhysics结合确定性模拟与视频生成，同时为模拟器状态、几何证据、生成器控制和外观记忆分配独立角色。对于每个动作，模拟器在生成相应观察之前计算有限的物理和相机轨迹。被接受的观察发布终端状态并更新外观记忆及随后的生成器控制，而已提交的状态和模拟器几何在合成和重试过程中保持固定。我们进一步将用于投影和可见性的模拟器几何与用于条件化生成器的相对深度分离。参考锚定记忆通过几何跨视图对应检索被接受的静态外观，并通过有界残差将其纳入，当不存在有效对应时则回归到原生路径。在模拟器定义的相机巡游和物体操作中，TourPhysics比评估的基线更紧密地遵循规定的相机和物体轨迹，保持输入场景，并在长时间跨度重访期间减少外观漂移。

title: From Language Models to World-Acting Systems: Progress and Limits of Agentic AI across Digital, Social, Virtual, and Physical Environments
comment: Review article. 29 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Literature cutoff: 31 August 2026
summary: Large language models become consequential agents when surrounding systems let outputs change external state. Models now call tools, operate interfaces, delegate work, retain state, inhabit generated worlds, and control robots or laboratory equipment. Such advances are often narrated as one march toward autonomy, conflating model competence, system integration, persistence, and safe authority. This critical review synthesizes primary research and official technical specifications available by 31 August 2026. We organize the evidence along delegated authority, temporal persistence, and environmental coupling, while separating model, harness, and environment. Within the evidence examined, action-interface expansion is documented more convincingly than robust completion, recovery, authorization, or independent verification. Model Context Protocol and Agent2Agent improve interoperability but do not establish trustworthy delegation; multi-agent organization adds specialization alongside cost and correlated failure. Persistent simulations and world models support training and planning but do not themselves demonstrate agency; robotics and self-driving laboratories establish bounded feasibility rather than unattended open-world reliability. We propose justified delegation as an analytical and normative heuristic, not an observed law or certified score: expand action scope only where evidence supports provenance, bounded authority, failure detection, safe recovery, and calibrated human control. This framing yields a research agenda for coupled model-harness evaluation, capability-based permissions, durable state, cross-agent accountability, and staged physical validation.

AI.title_zh: 从语言模型到世界行动系统：智能体AI在数字、社会、虚拟和物理环境中的进展与局限
AI.abstract_zh: 当周围系统使输出能够改变外部状态时，大型语言模型便成为具有重大影响的智能体。模型现在能够调用工具、操作界面、委派工作、保留状态、存在于生成的世界中，并控制机器人或实验室设备。此类进展常常被叙述为向自主性迈进的一场行军，将模型能力、系统集成、持久性和安全授权混为一谈。本批判性综述综合了截至2026年8月31日可获取的主要研究及官方技术规范。我们沿着委派权限、时间持久性和环境耦合来组织证据，同时区分模型、框架（harness）和环境。在所审阅的证据中，操作—接口扩展的证据记录比鲁棒的完成、恢复、授权或独立验证更有说服力。模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol）和Agent2Agent改善了互操作性，但并未建立可信的委派；多智能体组织在增加专业化的同时也带来了成本和相关性故障。持久模拟和世界模型支持训练和规划，但其本身并未展示行动能力（agency）；机器人学和自驱动实验室确立了有界可行性，而非无人值守的开放世界可靠性。我们提出“正当委派”（justified delegation）作为分析性和规范性启发式方法，而非观察到的定律或认证分数：仅在证据支持溯源、有界权限、故障检测、安全恢复和校准的人类控制之处，才扩展行动范围。这一框架为耦合模型—框架评估、基于能力的权限、持久状态、跨智能体问责和分阶段物理验证提供了一份研究议程。

title: Reasoning Without Inference Cost: Latent Semantic Scaffolding for Robot VLA Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are trained by imitation and capture what action to take but not why; adding causal reasoning improves manipulation, but current methods pay for it at inference time - generating reasoning tokens or rolling out predicted future states at every step, a cost that compounds over long horizons. We ask whether this benefit can instead be captured during training and discarded before deployment. We introduce Latent Semantic Scaffolding (LSS), an auxiliary loss applied during human-demonstration pretraining that aligns a VLA's action-token representations to text embeddings of physical-reasoning rationales through a small projection head. The head is dropped at inference, leaving the unmodified base policy with zero added cost. Our central finding concerns alignment granularity: aligning each action token to the rationale of its own manipulation phase (Dense LSS) rather than to a single pooled episode-level embedding (Pooled LSS) yields representations that transfer markedly better to held-out tasks. Dense LSS attains both the best in-distribution success and the best transfer to tasks unseen during alignment, whereas pooled alignment over-specializes to the training task. A representational probe shows Dense LSS induces roughly twice the per-phase separability in the backbone, supporting that phase-local alignment is the operative mechanism.

AI.title_zh: 无推理代价的推理：面向机器人VLA策略的潜在语义脚手架
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过模仿进行训练，并捕获应采取什么动作，但不捕获为何采取该动作；加入因果推理可以改善操作能力，但当前方法在推理阶段为此付出代价——每一步都生成推理标记或展开预测的未来状态，这种代价在长时间跨度任务中会不断累积。我们探究这种收益是否可以在训练期间被捕获并在部署前被丢弃。我们引入了潜在语义脚手架（Latent Semantic Scaffolding, LSS），这是一种在人类示范预训练期间应用的辅助损失，通过一个小型投影头将VLA的动作标记表示与物理推理依据的文本嵌入对齐。该投影头在推理时被丢弃，从而以零额外代价保留未经修改的基础策略。我们的核心发现涉及对齐粒度：将每个动作标记与其自身操作阶段（阶段稠密LSS，Dense LSS）的依据对齐，而非对齐到单一的池化回合级嵌入（池化LSS，Pooled LSS），所得到的表示能够在测试任务上显著更好地迁移。阶段稠密LSS在分布内成功率和对齐期间未见任务的迁移方面均取得最佳表现，而池化对齐则过度特化于训练任务。一种表示探针表明，阶段稠密LSS在骨干网络中诱导出约两倍的逐阶段可分离性，支持了阶段局部对齐是起作用机制的结论。

title: PRISM-Bench: An Audio-Centric Diagnostic Benchmark for Text-to-Audio-Video Generation
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). This arXiv version includes supplementary appendices not included in the conference proceedings version
summary: Text-to-audio-video (T2AV) generation has advanced rapidly, but its evaluation still underestimates the audio modality. Existing benchmarks either treat audio as an auxiliary component of video quality or assess it in isolation from audiovisual grounding, making it difficult to diagnose where current systems truly succeed or fail in audio generation. We present PRISM-Bench, the first audio-centric diagnostic benchmark for T2AV generation. Built from a rigorously curated dataset of 900 human-verified samples, PRISM-Bench factorizes audio evaluation along two orthogonal axes: audio type (Speech, Music, and Sound) and sound-source visibility (On-screen vs. Off-screen). It evaluates generated content across four perceptual dimensions (Audio-Visual Coherence, Audio Quality, Audio Expressiveness, and Prompt Following) with 35 fine-grained criteria. To ensure reliable assessment, we adopt an enhanced MLLM-as-a-Judge protocol based on blind, side-by-side comparison against ground-truth references, demonstrating strong alignment (over 70% mean agreement) with human raters. Our evaluation of recent T2AV systems highlights a significant performance gap between frontier and open-source models. Furthermore, we demonstrate that current generation paradigms overfit to perceptual fidelity while struggling with complex grounding and control tasks, particularly in generating music and synchronized On-screen audio.

AI.title_zh: PRISM-Bench：面向文本到音视频生成的首个以音频为中心的诊断基准
AI.abstract_zh: 文本到音视频（T2AV）生成技术发展迅速，但其评估仍然低估了音频模态。现有基准要么将音频视为视频质量的辅助组成部分，要么脱离视听锚定来孤立地评估音频，这使得难以诊断当前系统在音频生成方面真正的成功之处或失败之处。我们提出了PRISM-Bench，这是首个面向T2AV生成的以音频为中心的诊断基准。PRISM-Bench基于一个严格筛选的900个人工验证样本数据集构建，沿两个正交轴对音频评估进行分解：音频类型（语音、音乐和声音）以及声源可见性（画面内与画面外）。它从四个感知维度（视听一致性、音频质量、音频表现力和提示跟随）对生成内容进行评估，共包含35项细粒度标准。为确保评估的可靠性，我们采用了一种基于盲测、与地面真值参考进行并排比较的增强型多模态大模型作为评审（MLLM-as-a-Judge）协议，证明了其与人类评分者具有很强的对齐性（平均一致性超过70%）。我们对近期T2AV系统的评估凸显了前沿模型与开源模型之间的显著性能差距。此外，我们证明当前的生成范式过度追求感知保真度，却在复杂的锚定和控制任务上表现吃力，尤其是在生成音乐和同步的画面内音频方面。

title: Coupled Control and Wireless World Models for Resilient Remote Robotic Control
comment: 13 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Remote robotic systems operating over wireless networks must maintain reliable control despite limited communication resources, changing channel conditions, and environmental disturbances.However, continuously transmitting high-dimensional sensory observations, such as camera images, increases communication overhead and energy consumption while reducing robustness under unreliable connectivity.To address these challenges, this paper proposes a resilient communication-aware remote robotic control framework based on coupled control and wireless Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models that jointly capture robot dynamics and wireless channel evolution from visual observations and a combination of raw and structured radio frequency (RF) representations based on spectrograms and Persistence Images(PIs).The learned latent representations enable predictive communication scheduling by jointly forecasting future robot states and wireless conditions, thereby reducing unnecessary uplink transmissions while maintaining reliable control performance.Furthermore, an adaptive resilience mechanism detects latent prediction discrepancies and efficiently adapts perception embeddings to accommodate wireless and visual environmental changes without retraining the complete control policy.The proposed framework is evaluated in a synchronized Gazebo-Robot Operating System (ROS)-Sionna robot-wireless simulation environment under diverse wireless propagation and perception perturbations.Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in communication efficiency, robustness, and resilience while maintaining navigation performance compared with conventional Proportional Integral Derivative (PID), model-free Deep Q-Network (DQN), and predictive approaches based on Vision Transformers(ViTs).

AI.title_zh: 用于弹性远程机器人控制的耦合控制与无线路世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 运行在无线网络上的远程机器人系统必须在有限的通信资源、变化的信道条件和环境干扰下保持可靠控制。然而，连续传输诸如摄像机图像等高维感知观测会增加通信开销和能量消耗，同时降低在不可靠连接下的鲁棒性。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于耦合控制与无线联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型的通信感知远程机器人控制框架，该框架从视觉观测以及基于频谱图和持久性图像（PIs）的原始与结构化射频（RF）表示组合中，联合捕获机器人动力学和无线信道演化。学习到的潜在表示通过联合预测未来机器人状态和无线条件实现预测性通信调度，从而在保持可靠控制性能的同时减少不必要的上行传输。此外，一种自适应弹性机制检测潜在预测差异，并高效调整感知嵌入以适应无线和视觉环境变化，而无需重新训练完整的控制策略。所提出的框架在同步的Gazebo-机器人操作系统（ROS）-Sionna机器人-无线仿真环境中，在多种无线传播和感知扰动下进行了评估。实验结果表明，与传统的比例积分微分（PID）、无模型深度Q网络（DQN）以及基于视觉变换器（ViTs）的预测方法相比，所提方法在保持导航性能的同时，在通信效率、鲁棒性和弹性方面均有显著提升。

title: Where to Look Matters: Learning Influential Views for VLM-based 3D Visual Grounding
summary: Recent zero-shot 3D visual grounding methods leverage vision-language models (VLMs) to localize objects in 3D scenes from natural language queries. However, these methods typically rely on heuristic rules to select which camera views are provided to the VLM, often prioritizing object visibility rather than grounding relevance. We present IVSGround, a framework that learns Influential View Selection for VLM-based 3D visual grounding. Instead of using fixed heuristics, a lightweight view selector is trained to identify views that provide discriminative evidence for grounding. To obtain supervision signals, we generate training signals using feedback from a reasoning VLM through a two-stage rejection sampling process. During inference, the learned selector predicts query-conditioned influential views for each candidate object, which are then evaluated by a frozen reasoning VLM through comparative grounding. Experiments on ScanRefer and NR3D show that IVSGround consistently improves grounding accuracy over existing zero-shot pipelines, demonstrating that selecting where to look is crucial for effective 3D visual grounding. Project page: https://ivsground.github.io/

AI.title_zh: 看向何处至关重要：为基于VLM的3D视觉定位学习有影响力的视角
AI.abstract_zh: 近期零样本3D视觉定位方法利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从自然语言查询中定位3D场景中的物体。然而，这些方法通常依赖启发式规则来选择提供给VLM的相机视角，往往优先考虑物体的可见性而非定位相关性。我们提出了IVSGround，一个为基于VLM的3D视觉定位学习有影响力视角选择的框架。与使用固定启发式规则不同，一个轻量级视角选择器经过训练，用于识别能够为定位提供判别性证据的视角。为了获得监督信号，我们通过一个两阶段拒绝采样过程，利用推理型VLM的反馈生成训练信号。在推理阶段，学习到的选择器为每个候选物体预测基于查询条件的有影响力视角，随后由冻结的推理型VLM通过比较式定位进行评估。在ScanRefer和NR3D上的实验表明，IVSGround consistently优于现有零样本piplines从根本上提升了定位精度，证明选择看向何处对于有效的3D视觉定位至关重要。项目页面：https://ivsground.github.io/

title: ReaDiT Guidance: Control for Image and Video Generation using Diffusion Transformer Features
summary: We present DiT Readout (ReaDiT) Guidance, a lightweight framework for controlling generation with Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models via their internal feature representations. ReaDiT Guidance uses features from a single DiT block to steer the generative process according to spatial targets - like depth, pose, or edge maps - provided at test time. Furthermore, since modern text-to-video models are largely built on DiT backbones, ReaDiT Guidance naturally extends to video generation, enabling camera and motion control. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive or improved results compared to existing feature-based and off-the-shelf adapter-based approaches while requiring fewer parameters.

AI.title_zh: ReaDiT引导：利用扩散Transformer特征进行图像与视频生成的控制
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出了DiT读出（ReaDiT）引导，这是一个轻量级框架，通过扩散Transformer（DiT）模型的内部特征表示来控制生成过程。ReaDiT引导利用单个DiT块的特征，根据测试时提供的空间目标（如深度、姿态或边缘图）来引导生成过程。此外，由于现代文本到视频模型主要基于DiT骨干架构构建，ReaDiT引导自然扩展到视频生成，实现了相机和运动控制。实验结果表明，与现有的基于特征的方法和现成的基于适配器的方法相比，我们的方法在需要更少参数的情况下取得了具有竞争力或更好的结果。

title: Open-Set 3D Scene Graphs for Field Robotics: An Outdoor Case Study
comment: This work has been accepted for publication with the IEEE Transactions of Field Robotics Journal
summary: Three-dimensional scene graphs (3DSGs) have emerged as a promising approach for building geometrically grounded, semantically informed, hierarchical general-purpose maps to support high-level robotic reasoning. However, the behavior of 3DSGs in real-world outdoor deployments remains poorly understood, particularly when combined with open-set vision-language models (VLMs). In this field report, we analyze the components common to most 3DSG representations across five outdoor robotic datasets to characterize challenges that arise in complex outdoor environments. Using the recently proposed Terra 3DSG as a case study, we investigate semantic point embeddings, place-node graph navigation, region-level understanding, and memory size across the five diverse datasets. We additionally introduce novel consistency metrics to evaluate whether semantic and structural graph properties remain stable across repeated traversals of the same environment. Our analysis reveals that outliers and multiple modes are common in VLM point embeddings across all tested datasets with outlier ratios above $0.1$ for around $30\%$ of points. We demonstrate the feasibility of outdoor 3DSGs for navigation-based object retrieval, achieving success rates near $70\%$, though performance is limited by traversability failures and inefficient routing, with trajectories averaging approximately $66\%$ suboptimal path efficiency. Region-level understanding remains challenging in complex natural environments, with low average F1 scores around $0.359$. Overall, our results show that outdoor 3DSGs can maintain compact (less than $600$MB for multi-kilometer trajectories) and relatively consistent large-scale environment representations, while highlighting open challenges in handling multiple semantic modes, incorporating traversability into graph structures, and improving higher-level region understanding.

AI.title_zh: 面向现场机器人的开放集三维场景图：一项室外案例研究
AI.abstract_zh: 三维场景图（3DSGs）已成为构建几何基础扎实、语义信息丰富、层级化的通用地图以支持高层机器人推理的一种有前景的方法。然而，三维场景图在真实世界室外部署中的表现仍鲜为人知，尤其是当其与开放集视觉语言模型（VLMs）结合时。在本实地报告中，我们分析了大多数三维场景图表示所共有的组件，跨越五个室外机器人数据集，以刻画复杂室外环境中出现的挑战。以最近提出的Terra 3DSG作为案例研究，我们考察了语义点嵌入、地点节点图导航、区域级理解以及跨五个多样数据集的记忆体大小。此外，我们引入了新颖的一致性度量，以评估语义和结构图属性在同一环境重复遍历中是否保持稳定。我们的分析揭示，在所有测试数据集中，VLM点嵌入中异常值和多模态是常见的，约30%的点其异常值比率高于0.1。我们证明了室外三维场景图在基于导航的目标检索方面的可行性，成功率达到近70%，尽管性能受到可穿越性失败和低效路径规划的制约，轨迹的平均次优路径效率约为66%。在复杂的自然环境中，区域级理解仍然具有挑战性，平均F1分数较低，约为0.359。总体而言，我们的结果表明，室外三维场景图能够维持紧凑（多公里轨迹小于600MB）且相对一致的大规模环境表示，同时凸显了在处理多个语义模态、将可穿越性纳入图结构以及改进更高层区域理解方面的开放性挑战。

title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
summary: Unattended interactive autonomy - machines that step into danger in place of humans and complete tasks with human tools - remains a missing capability in mission-critical operations. These domains offer scarce training data and only onboard compute, yet deployed systems must face novelty without erasing prior competence. We introduce Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs), which learn efficiently in the lab and continue learning after deployment through autonomous, gradient-free, on-device updates. CFAM uses a complementary learning architecture with a frozen slow-learning component and a fast-learning Capsule Field. The slow component contains three cortices: Sensor, which maps multimodal input into 3D-grounded geometry; Reasoning, which decomposes tasks into skills and evaluates outcomes; and Action, which executes geometric skills. The Capsule Field stores field learning one-shot and gradient-free as Competence Capsules. Skill installation is few-shot in the lab and continual in the field; open-world novelty is outside scope. We evaluate CFAM across five embodiments: manipulator, quadruped, humanoid, quadrotor, and off-road vehicle. Baselines (pi0, CogACT, SpatialVLA) use the same in-house multi-embodiment dataset for physical-platform comparisons. CFAM reaches the operating point of a standard policy trained on the full prior-training dataset using 40% of the data, or 2.5x fewer trajectories. At test time, autonomous capture of verified near-OOD cases improves action success by 13.9 percentage points. In sequential simulation, backward transfer is -0.5 percentage points versus -11.4 for LoRA. CFAM therefore provides a bounded form of post-deployment physical intelligence: few-shot skill learning, autonomous field growth from verified near-OOD experience, and retention of prior competence.

AI.title_zh: 持续场自适应模型（CFAMs）用于部署后物理人工智能
AI.abstract_zh: 无人值守的交互式自主能力——机器代替人类进入危险环境并使用人类工具完成任务——在关键任务操作中仍是一项缺失的能力。这些领域提供的训练数据稀缺，且仅有板载计算资源，然而部署后的系统必须面对新奇情况而不抹除先前的能力。我们引入持续场自适应模型（CFAMs），该模型在实验室中高效学习，并在部署后通过自主、无梯度、设备端更新持续学习。CFAM采用互补学习架构，包含一个冻结的慢学习组件和一个快学习的胶囊场（Capsule Field）。慢学习组件包含三个皮层：传感器皮层（Sensor），将多模态输入映射为基于3D的几何表示；推理皮层（Reasoning），将任务分解为技能并评估结果；以及动作皮层（Action），执行几何技能。胶囊场以能力胶囊（Competence Capsules）的形式以一次性、无梯度的方式存储场学习。技能安装采用实验室中少样本、现场中持续学习的方式；开放世界的新奇情况不在本工作范围内。我们在五种具身形态上评估CFAM：机械臂、四足机器人、人形机器人、四旋翼无人机和越野车辆。基线模型（pi0、CogACT、SpatialVLA）使用相同的内部多样具身数据集进行物理平台对比。CFAM使用完整先前训练数据集40%的数据（即减少2.5倍轨迹）即可达到标准策略的运行点。在测试时，对经验证的近分布外（near-OOD）案例进行自主捕获可将动作成功率提高13.9个百分点。在顺序模拟中，后向迁移为-0.5个百分点，而LoRA为-11.4个百分点。因此，CFAM提供了一种有界的部署后物理智能形式：少样本技能学习、从经验证的近分布外经验中自主实现场增长，以及保留先前能力。

title: Scalable Edge-assisted Fusion and Path Prediction for Connected Autonomous Vehicles
summary: The planning algorithms inside an Autonomous Vehicle (AV) rely on information from on-board sensors whose line of sight is limited by emerging traffic conditions and occlusions. Edge-assisted creation of a unified world model fusing information from AVs and Road Side Units (RSUs) in a geographical locale, and the prediction of AVs' future trajectories, can enhance the planning algorithms inside AVs to improve quality metrics, such as better traffic flow and collision prevention. AVs participating in such enhancements are called Connected Autonomous Vehicles (CAVs). However, such information generated by the edge (world model and motion predictions) must reach the planners within a tight Age of Information (AoI) time budget to be useful. The state of the art fuses per-CAV information: each AV fuses inputs from other actors locally, which limits both scalability with actor count and quality of results. We present Conductor, an edge-based solution for creating a unified world model from the perspective of a fixed anchor (e.g., an RSU) in a locale and predicting future trajectories of AVs in that locale. Our solution adheres to the AoI time budget by dynamically limiting the number of AVs that would lead to the best quality of results. Specifically, we introduce an occlusion-aware selector that favors information contribution by AVs that detect objects in the locale not covered by RSUs. We pair this selector with a runtime controller that adapts both the number of AV inputs to fuse and the amount of trajectory predictions in each cycle to stay within the AoI time budget. Evaluation on CAV simulation infrastructure shows our joint selector-controller meets the AoI safety bound across traffic scenarios with up to 31 CAVs, with fusion fidelity close to an Oracle and much better than a random selector under the same AoI constraint.

AI.title_zh: 面向网联自动驾驶汽车的可扩展边缘辅助融合与路径预测
AI.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶汽车（AV）内部的规划算法依赖于车载传感器的信息，而这些传感器的视线受到当前的交通状况和遮挡物的限制。边缘辅助构建统一世界模型，融合某一地理区域内自动驾驶汽车和路侧单元（RSU）的信息，并预测自动驾驶汽车的未来轨迹，可以增强自动驾驶汽车内部的规划算法，从而改善质量指标，如更优的交通流量和碰撞预防。参与此类增强功能的自动驾驶汽车被称为网联自动驾驶汽车（CAV）。然而，边缘生成的信息（世界模型和运动预测）必须在严格的信息年龄（AoI）时间预算内到达规划器才能发挥作用。现有技术是按CAV分别融合的：每辆自动驾驶汽车在本地融合来自其他参与者的输入，这既限制了随参与者数量增加的可扩展性，也限制了结果质量。我们提出了Conductor，一种基于边缘的解决方案，用于从某一地点的固定锚点（如RSU）的视角创建统一的世界模型，并预测该地点内自动驾驶汽车的未来轨迹。我们的解决方案通过动态限制能够产生最佳结果质量的自动驾驶汽车数量来满足AoI时间预算。具体来说，我们引入了一个面向遮挡的选择器，优先考虑那些能检测到RSU未覆盖区域中障碍物的自动驾驶汽车的信息贡献。我们将该选择器与一个运行时控制器配对，该控制器在每一周期内同时调整要融合的自动驾驶汽车输入数量和轨迹预测量，以保持在AoI时间预算之内。在CAV仿真基础设施上的评估表明，我们联合的选择器-控制器能够在包含多达31辆CAV的交通场景中满足AoI安全边界，其融合保真度接近Oracle，并且在相同的AoI约束下明显优于随机选择器。

title: Joint Alignment and Distillation for Video Generation via Sample-Guided Distribution Matching
summary: Aligning video generative models to human preferences heavily relies on Reinforcement Learning (RL), which suffers from extensive computational overhead. Existing workflows typically treat RL and distillation as disconnected stages: applying RL before distillation incurs prohibitive computational costs, whereas applying RL after distillation frequently leads to model collapse. To overcome these limitations, we propose a unified, single-stage optimization framework grounded in Distribution Matching (DM). In the standard DM framework, distillation updates the model via a gradient direction that minimizes the gap between the real and fake models, guiding generations toward clarity and high fidelity. Building upon this, we introduce DM-Align, which derives a complementary gradient direction to guide the model toward human-preferred samples. Inspired by DPO and GRPO, our method leverages the distributional gap -- formulated from either preference pairs or intra-group exploration -- to directly construct this preference-guided gradient. By synergizing these two gradient directions, our approach eliminates the need for multi-step reward evaluation and complex ODE-SDE conversions inherent in traditional RL. Comprehensive experiments across multiple foundational video models demonstrate that this sample-guided framework robustly enhances both distillation quality and preference alignment, consistently outperforming both standalone variants and sequential two-stage pipelines.

AI.title_zh: 基于样本引导分布匹配的视频生成联合对齐与蒸馏
AI.abstract_zh: 将视频生成模型与人类偏好对齐在很大程度上依赖于强化学习（RL），而强化学习面临大量计算开销。现有工作流程通常将强化学习与蒸馏视为两个脱节的阶段：在蒸馏之前应用强化学习会产生高昂的计算成本，而在蒸馏之后应用强化学习则常常导致模型崩溃。为克服这些局限，我们提出了一种统一的单阶段优化框架，其理论基础为分布匹配（DM）。在标准分布匹配框架中，蒸馏通过最小化真实模型与伪造模型之间差距的梯度方向来更新模型，引导生成结果趋向于清晰和高保真。在此基础之上，我们引入DM-Align，推导出一个互补的梯度方向，以引导模型趋向于人类偏好的样本。受DPO和GRPO的启发，我们的方法利用分布差距——由偏好对或组内探索构建而成——来直接构造这一偏好引导梯度。通过协同利用这两个梯度方向，我们的方法消除了传统强化学习中对多步奖励评估和复杂ODE-SDE转换的需求。在多种基础视频模型上的综合实验表明，这一样本引导框架能够稳健地同时提升蒸馏质量和偏好对齐，持续优于单独的变体以及顺序两阶段流水线。

title: Spectral-Target Physical Latent Structuring for JEPA-Style World Models
summary: Latent world models have become increasingly popular as a method to predict and plan in latent space rather than pixel space. Recent architectures, such as LeWorldModel (LeWM), jointly train the encoder and predictor using regularization techniques like SIGReg to prevent representation collapse. Even with such regularization preventing representation collapse, we identify a new world model failure mode of \textit{physical representation laziness}, particularly noted in highly dynamic environments. For these lazy cases, the learned latent states do not collapse but nonetheless fail to represent key physical properties, causing ubiquitous downstream planning failure. To resolve this issue, we propose training-time auxiliary supervision with a lightweight "Fourier auxiliary head", which enforces physically-informed structuring of the latent space with no additional inference-time cost and can be generalized to any environment. Experimentally, we show that the auxiliary head substantially improves planning success rates in dynamic environments where the baseline LeWM exhibits physical representation laziness. It also leads to modest improvements in other environments, even when the baseline does not exhibit physical representation laziness. We further observe superior planning performance being accompanied by higher latent space correlations with key physical properties, indicating both the ability of our method to physically structure latent states and the potential planning-side benefit to the learned representation being physically structured. We also see in low-data regimes, auxiliary supervision is particularly impactful in increasing success rate. These findings support the use of our Fourier auxiliary head method to improve both overall success rate and data efficiency, while avoiding representation laziness in latent world models.

AI.title_zh: 面向JEPA式世界模型的谱目标物理潜在结构化
AI.abstract_zh: 潜在世界模型作为一种在潜在空间而非像素空间中进行预测和规划的方法已变得越来越流行。近期架构（如LeWorldModel，简称LeWM）利用SIGReg等正则化技术联合训练编码器和预测器，以防止表征坍缩。即使此类正则化能够防止表征坍缩，我们仍识别出一种新的世界模型失效模式，即\textit{物理表征惰性}（physical representation laziness），尤其在高度动态环境中显著。在惰性情形下，学习到的潜在状态并未坍缩，但却未能表征关键物理属性，从而导致普遍的下游规划失效。为解决该问题，我们提出训练时的辅助监督方法，采用轻量级"傅里叶辅助头"（Fourier auxiliary head），在不增加任何推理时开销的情况下强化潜在空间的物理信息结构化，且可推广至任意环境。实验表明，在基线LeWM表现出物理表征惰性的动态环境中，辅助头显著提升了规划成功率；在其他环境中，即使基线未表现出物理表征惰性，该方法也能带来适度改进。我们进一步观察到，更优的规划性能伴随着潜在空间与关键物理属性之间更高的相关性，这表明我们的方法既能对潜在状态进行物理结构化，又能为学习到的表征带来规划侧的潜在收益。我们还发现，在低数据场景下，辅助监督对提高成功率尤为有效。这些发现支持使用我们的傅里叶辅助头方法来提升整体成功率和数据效率，同时避免潜在世界模型中的表征惰性问题。

title: Encore: Infinite Audio-Video Generation with Adaptive Signal Routing
summary: Existing audio-video generation methods produce well-synchronized clips but are limited to short durations, while long-video generation methods extend duration through chunk-based iterative synthesis yet lack audio entirely. Generating long audio-video jointly is fundamentally harder than either task alone: each chunk must simultaneously maintain video temporal coherence, audio temporal coherence, and cross-modal synchronization, whose conditioning signals enter the model through different pathways. In this work, we present Encore for long-form synchronized audio-video generation. Our key insight is to factor this challenge into: (1) local continuity handled by iterative generation with explicit cross-chunk context propagation, and (2) global consistency enforced via reference audio-video signals with shifted position embedding. Building on this design, we propose Adaptive Signal Routing (ASR), which introduces learnable attention biases within self-attention and learnable residual scales on cross-attention outputs, enabling the model to adaptively modulate the influence of each conditioning signal. Trained end-to-end for joint audio-video generation, Encore also supports infinite-length audio-to-video and video-to-audio synthesis at inference by conditioning on the ground-truth modality throughout the denoising process. Experiments on our extended VerseBench for long audio-video evaluation demonstrate that Encore significantly outperforms existing methods in both generation quality and temporal coherence. Code and data for this paper are at https://github.com/shaohua-pan/Encore.

AI.title_zh: Encore：基于自适应信号路由的无限音视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 现有的音视频生成方法能够产生同步良好的片段，但仅限于较短时长，而长视频生成方法通过分块迭代合成来延长时长，却完全缺乏音频。联合生成长音频与长视频在本质上比单独完成任一任务都更为困难：每个分块必须同时维持视频时间连贯性、音频时间连贯性以及跨模态同步，而这些条件信号通过不同的路径进入模型。在本工作中，我们提出Encore用于长时间同步音视频生成。我们的关键洞察是将这一挑战分解为：(1) 通过带显式跨块上下文传播的迭代生成来处理局部连贯性，以及(2) 通过带偏移位置嵌入的参考音视频信号来强制全局一致性。基于这一设计，我们提出自适应信号路由（Adaptive Signal Routing，ASR），它在自注意力中引入可学习的注意力偏置，并在交叉注意力输出上引入可学习的残差缩放，使模型能够自适应地调节每种条件信号的影响。Encore以端到端方式训练用于联合音视频生成，在推理时通过在整个去噪过程中对真实模态进行条件化，也支持无限长度的音频到视频和视频到音频合成。我们在扩展的VerseBench上进行的长时间音视频评估实验表明，Encore在生成质量与时间连贯性方面均显著优于现有方法。本文的代码和数据见https://github.com/shaohua-pan/Encore。
